channel.title: BRSSUG | Baton Rouge SQL Server User Group
channel.description: BRSSUG is a free, no-registration-required user group for SQL Server and data platform professionals in Baton Rouge, LA. We meet monthly at Jones Creek Regional Library.

item.title: Breaking the Curse of Knowledge — Communicating Clearly With Non‑Technical Teams
item.description: This talk explores one of the biggest hidden barriers to effective communication between technical and non‑technical teams: the Curse of Knowledge. Once you understand something deeply, it becomes almost impossible to remember what it was like not to know it. This bias leads experts to skip steps, use jargon unconsciously, overload explanations, and assume shared context that doesn’t exist. The…

item.title: Transition from Data Analyst to Data Engineer: Upgrading Skills from DataFlows Gen2 to Notebooks
item.description: The session shows an analyst how to use notebooks to perform the same actions as Dataflow Gen2. Looking at 4 areas: source, transformation, cleansing, and destination, examples include append/merge query to dataframe joins, text replace functionality, split and concatenate columns, as well as pivot/unpivot, data type changes, and removing duplicates. We will finish off with engine optimizations.

item.title: How AI is Changing Successful Engagements in the Current Federal Landscape
item.description: Burton White, CEO of Excella, will discuss how AI is changing the roles, skills, and team structures needed to deliver successful engagements in the current federal landscape. All are welcome. Bring a friend!

item.title: BRUG Board Meeting and Info Session
item.description: Do you want to get involved with the Baton Rouge User Groups? Join us at our annual board meeting to give your input into the groups and even volunteer for a leadership position. We're looking for your ideas and help to make the groups what you want them to be.

item.title: Introduction to Vibe Coding
item.description: Join us to learn about vibe coding and help build a QR scanning app for SQL Saturday Day of Data. This will be interactive and live, so anything can happen! Learn about using LLMs and AI to build apps. This month's meeting is being sponsored by SQL Saturday Day of Data.

item.title: What is Power BI Developer Mode?
item.description: Power BI Developer Mode changes how Power BI development works day to day. This session covers the PBIP file format and what it enables, how Developer Mode improves version control for Power BI projects, and practical tips for using it on a team.

item.title: Data Modernization and AI: A Cloud Warehouse Journey
item.description: Benjamin Claxton explores the evolution from legacy SQL Server to cloud-native Google BigQuery, covering migration pressures, modern data engineering practices with CI/CD and DevOps, and how cloud warehousing, DevOps practices, and AI fit together as stages in a broader data modernization journey.

item.title: Own Your Workflow: Build Notebooks Locally & Deploy Them to Fabric
item.description: Break free from browser IDE in Fabric Python and PySpark Notebooks! Learn to install Python and Spark, create your own local lakehouse, and develop Python and PySpark Notebooks in Visual Studio, VSCode, or whatever IDE you're used to. We'll start with a clean machine and download, install and configure everything we need. We will create a feature-rich notebook, and wrap up by deploying to Fabric.

item.title: Amazon Product and Seller Analysis Dashboard
item.description: Amazon Product and Seller Analysis Dashboard is a personal project that implements a complete ETL pipeline, from data extraction to advanced analytical insights, using historical Amazon data stored and analyzed in Snowflake, loaded and visualized through a Power BI dashboard to support business analysis.

item.title: Enhancing Power BI with Copilot
item.description: Copilot in Power BI streamlines data modeling and report-building through intelligent suggestions, natural language query generation, and context-aware insights. Developers can describe desired outcomes in plain English and Copilot will generate DAX formulas, visuals, and entire report structures.
